nodes.text:
So. The Crown's surveyor lost her papers in the burn and sends a stranger to ask my leave. That is the most honest thing her office has done all year, and I suspect it was your idea.

Go and get them. Break the shift politely, if a shift can be broken politely. But you carry my words back with the pages: the next question the Crown has for this town knocks at the Delfhall first, or it walks home.
